overview: The Medford Energy and Environment Committee met remotely to review administrative updates, plan for the upcoming Harvest Your Energy Festival, receive updates on the city's solid waste contract process, and confer with City Councillor Nicole Morell on the draft tree ordinance.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes of previous meetings as amended with minor spelling corrections.

items.title: Administrative and Program Updates
items.summary: Staff and members discussed intern hiring, creating weekly environmental tips for the mayor's social media, staffing the Mystic River celebration, invasive species management, and climate funding opportunities.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Planning
items.summary: Lauretta James presented status updates on exhibitor registration, volunteer recruiting, vendor logistics, and complementary events for the October 15 festival.

items.title: Solid Waste Contract and Zero-Waste Initiatives
items.summary: Alicia Hunt reported on the solid waste task force survey and upcoming RFP process, followed by committee discussion on long-term zero-waste goals and school recycling infrastructure.

items.title: Tree Ordinance Discussion with Councillor Morell
items.summary: City Councillor Nicole Morell updated the committee on committee-of-the-whole deliberations regarding the proposed tree ordinance, municipal enforcement constraints, and legal guidance concerning private tree protections.

items.title: General Business and Recycling Education
items.summary: Members discussed upcoming guest presentations on building electrification and reviewed public education strategies to reduce recycling contamination.
